name: postsocket
description: PostSocket: live blogs and articles that update in every reader's browser as you publish.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build && tsc -p tsconfig.reader.json && node bin/reader-assets.mjs
scripts.make-pot: php -d memory_limit=2G "$(command -v wp)" i18n make-pot . languages/postsocket.pot --slug=postsocket --domain=postsocket --exclude=node_modules,vendor,tests,artifacts,src
scripts.test: npm run test:php && npm run test:e2e
